source_scope: Fresh public official SDMX responses plus explicitly labelled retained-export geography/unit/notes metadata
scope_review: No contrary notes, observation flags or license annotations were provided in these specific responses; not a blanket clearance of all Ukrstat material.
transformations: Select 2021 GRP, REGION, _Z, A; map 1090/6 to UAH millions using retained official explorer metadata; no numeric rescaling, sector allocation or scoring integration.
limitations: 2021 benchmark is not a wartime estimate.
Retained geography/footnotes are labelled archived, not freshly authenticated metadata.
Fresh source observations do not recover historical retrieval dates or original ZIP bytes.
Territorial coverage and comparability require source-footnote review; no claim of complete present-day territorial coverage.
